name: boat-player-ride
comment: WP-2.4b. The pool of entity/boat-on-water. The player (id 0) stands on the west rim; a boat (id 1) is spawned on the water at (-3.5, 60, 0.5) and floats up. At t = 5 the interact op (the ENTITY branch of Minecraft.clickMouse(1): EntityBoat.interact, EntityBoat.java:336-346) puts the player in the boat (Entity.mountEntity); from then on World.updateEntityWithOptionalForce updates the rider after the boat and EntityBoat.updateRiderPosition places it 0.4 ahead along the boat's yaw. The boat steers by the rider's motionX/Z * 0.2 (:195-198), which the player's own update leaves at 0 with no input. At t = 20 set_motion (0.35, 0, 0.25) sends the boat with its rider into the south rim on the diagonal: it breaks (motionZ zeroed, motionX above 0.15, :246-258) and drops 3 planks and 2 sticks; World.updateEntities then unlinks the rider from the dead boat. Only the boat and its drops are dumped (entity_state which [1..6]): the player's own update is EntityPlayer's (WP-2.5), and the run ends before the drops' pickup delay runs out (the player would pick them up at t = 46). rng_state every tick.
